content:
Maya: Quick coordination thread — I'm reworking the Optimize toolkit examples into a compact 'patterns' section so users get quick decision guidance (batching vs kv-prefetch vs prefix). Draft PR inbound.

Rohit: Love that. Can you include one-line migration hints for customers still referencing old quant names? We keep getting support tickets.

Maya: Yes — will add a short migration callout: 'QuantProfile.ShortSeq -> QuantProfiles.short_sequence()' and sdk parity notes.

Theo: Tiny SDK nit: our Python examples should prefer the fluent builder (`OptimizeOptions().with_quant_profile(...)`) rather than setting fields after init. Less copy-paste.

Maya: Agreed. Will convert Python, Go, and JS snippets to the builder pattern.

ci-bot: Link check: 2 broken anchors detected: docs/optimize/kv-prefetch.md#prefetch and docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md#shortseq. Suggested fixes: #kv-prefetch-policy and #quant-profiles-short-sequence.

Rohit: Also recommend adding a one-liner about tradeoffs: short-seq quant reduces memory at slight quality loss for short prompts; long-batch quant is for throughput. Helps customers pick.

Maya: Adding that tradeoff note and a tiny decision table: 'low-latency short prompts -> short_sequence; high-throughput batched -> long_batch_profile; repeated prefixes -> prefix/KV caching'.

Theo: In YAML snippets, please quote auto values: `batch_size: \"auto\"` — some markdown renderers mess up unquoted tokens.

Maya: Done. I'll push the PR in ~25m and tag @Rohit and @Theo for quick review. Marking this in-progress.
